name: ECU Remapping Performance Calculator
author: Arrow Design

sections.description:
ECU Remapping Performance Calculator lets website visitors select a vehicle and view estimated power and torque gains available from ECU remapping.

The calculator supports vehicle selection by type, manufacturer, model, year and engine, with configurable presentation options for WordPress websites.

Third-Party Service

This plugin connects to a service operated by Arrow Design at arrowdesign.ie. The service is used to provide ECU remapping calculation data and to validate access to service features.

During validation, the plugin may transmit the configured account email, API key, website URL and information required to determine service access. Vehicle selections required to return calculation data are also sent when visitors use the calculator.

The service is required for the remote ECU remapping data supplied by the plugin. If the service cannot be reached, remote calculation data may be unavailable.

Privacy policy: https://arrowdesign.ie/ecu-mapping-calculator-privacy-policy/

Terms of use: https://arrowdesign.ie/ecu-mapping-calculator-terms-of-use/

Service provider: https://arrowdesign.ie/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ecu-remapping-performance-calculator/, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the ECU Remapping Performance Calculator settings page in WordPress admin.
  4. Configure the service credentials and calculator display options.
  5. Add the calculator using the native ECU Remapping Calculator block, or use the legacy [ECU_Tuning_Performance_Calculator] shortcode in Divi, Elementor and other builders.
sections.faq:
Are the performance figures guaranteed?

No. Figures returned by the calculator are estimates. Actual results can vary according to vehicle condition, specification, fuel, hardware and tuning configuration.

Does the plugin use an external service?

Yes. ECU remapping data and service-access validation are provided through the Arrow Design service described in the Third-Party Service section above.

  • Added optional business-defined stage pricing, disabled by default.

  • Added Copy Results sharing.

3.7.0

3.2.1
